posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
The nature of a multiverse means that the shattered timeline events are either universal to all timelines or they have to start in a timeline (or multiple ones).  For example, the timeline that Visionary travels from cannot be the same one she ends up in, because her appearance would start a new timeline.

If the timeline shattering is a multiverse encompassing event (a fixed point) then Visionary would have come from a timeline after the Timeline saga ends (since she left after the dates of Tactics, when SotM is over)

The Shattered Timeline events obviously affect time all over the place, but not those timelines that existed before the events of the shattered period.  If they did it wouldn't be a multiverse to begin with.

Look at the death of Legacy story, the original Young Legacy lore doesn't happen, but it should have.  The timeline changed, and then stopped changing, it normalized.

Also wanted to point out that Cosmic's shard couldn't be the awakening of Progeny, since Cosmic was part of the Prime Wardens before Progeny awoke.

posts.cooked:
I think the multiverse and the shattered timelines is the beginning, middle and end of the story. At the beginning we have visionary falling through the cracks of the multiverse and ending up in the present. Some where I think I read that the Visionary didn't cause the rips in reality, just exploited them. This tells me there is an event that rips spacetime creating the time cataclysm.

The middle of the story is where the actual shattered timelines expansion exists. The problem of these universes rubbing against each other becomes apparent when these dangerous entities start coming to the timeline. This part ends with Deadline, Wager Master and Progeny showing up, saying there are dark and dangerous things beyond Earth wanting to destroy the imbalance created on Earth. I think this imbalance is the time cataclysm.

The end of the story is the last expansion, obviously. We know that at the end the multiverse is closed, from Tactics. We also guess there is going to be some type of interaction with the Cosmonautilus. And the world is nearly destroyed. I have no idea what is going to happen here, but it involves heroes and villains fighting, if I were to guess. 

I think the first step in speculating on how the story is going to end, is to speculate on how it started. What shattered the time lines? Was is it the terraimpulsion beam? Was it Joseph Parsons saving Paul Revere? Was it actually Progeny landing on Earth, and the reason the Cosmonautilus is focused on Earth is unknown? Did the timelines shatter because Unity converted the Wraith's hairdryer into a nice pretty robot? I don't know but I think it is the place to start looking for answers.

posts.cooked: I had a Doctor Who style thought regarding the shattered timelines.  What if the Cosmic Entity arriving at earth was the cause of the shattering?  What if it acted like an explosion, but traveling in time not space?  So the smallest cracks would be far from the origin, like what Vanessa slipped through, but got progressively worse the closer to the event they go.  This would explain the more frequent crossovers in Shattered Timelines; they are not the cause but the effect.  So the last expansion could be the true shattering, not just cracks, and have all universes as one somehow if only for a short time.  That way if the Hero’s win, they can repair the timelines enough by the time Tactics comes around.
